subject: Northfield Trust: request for customer-specific KV seeding and 'lightning lane' prioritization
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodai.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-04-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Northfield Trust - ask for customer-specific KV seeding + 'lightning lane' prioritization

Team,

Quick context: Northfield Trust (procurement looped) is moving to an on-contract decision this quarter. They want a production readiness commitment that includes predictable low-latency during peak month-end loads and a sandbox for seeded session state to improve cold-start accuracy for their customer-facing workflows.

What they specifically asked in the RFP:
- Ability to seed a per-tenant KV snapshot (prefix cache) on deploy to warm critical prefixes for the first 10k active sessions.
- A prioritized "lightning lane" routing policy that pins a small pool during month-end windows (8–12 hours, predictable dates) to guarantee P95 latency under 300ms.

Why this matters for the deal:
- Procurement has a hard deadline 2027-04-15 for final SOW acceptance.
- If we can commit to a short-term activation plan, they will go annual with a significant committed spend (deal id NF-2027-Q2-47).

Ask: can Product + Eng give a feasibility signal and a proposed delivery window (MVP + optional hardening) that we can share with procurement by 4/12? Ideally we want:
1) Feasibility (yes/no) for seeded per-tenant KV snapshot ahead of go-live.
2) Estimated implementation scope (approx engineer-weeks) and risk flags.
3) Whether the lightning-lane routing + small reserved pool can be supported via config (preferred) or requires code changes.

I attached RFP excerpts and our initial SOW draft.

If it's easier, can we hop on a 30-min sync tomorrow? I'm available 10–12 PST.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwoodai.com
Attachments: northfield-map-reqs.pdf, SOW-draft-NF-47.docx

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodai.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Northfield Trust - ask for customer-specific KV seeding + 'lightning lane' prioritization

Grace — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. A couple of clarifying items before I commit to sizing:

1) Scope of the seeded KV snapshot: is the ask to support a one-time seed during onboarding (SOW-time) or continuous seeded refreshes (every deployment / weekly snapshot)?
2) Isolation model: should seeded prefixes be tenant-isolated in memory, or is it acceptable to reuse shared caches with tenant keys?
3) Traffic pattern: you mentioned "first 10k active sessions" — do we have an estimate of concurrent TTF/requests per second during peak?

If it's a one-time seed and shared-cache with tenant keys, we can likely support via existing cache APIs + a deployment hook for seeding; estimated 2–3 sprints including QA for a controlled rollout. If they need strict in-memory isolation and live refreshes, that's a larger change (4–6 sprints).

Lightning lane: short answer — we have the routing primitives to prioritize a small pool, but guaranteeing p95 <300ms at month-end peak depends on model size and quantization profile. We'll need to know which model variant they'd run and whether they'd accept an "affinity + graceful fallback" plan (i.e., pin to full-fidelity model until capacity exhausted then fall back to a quantized variant).

Can we get the answers above and a quick traffic spike estimate? If you can get procurement/engineering contact at Northfield to share typical RPS, that will speed things.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Product Manager, Platform
irene_choi@redwoodai.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodai.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodai@redwoodai.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Northfield Trust - ask for customer-specific KV seeding + 'lightning lane' prioritization

Irene, team — adding the Northfield context:

- They plan to route ~1.6k concurrent sessions at month-end with bursts to ~3.5k over a 2-hour window. Peak requests per second estimated at ~220rps (their infra contact confirmed).
- They prefer not to take fidelity loss at go-live; they are open to a staged plan where we commit to full-fidelity for the pilot month (on reserved pool) and a quantified fallback afterward.
- Procurement emphasized that a deliverable timeline in the SOW is required; otherwise they will delay acceptance and push the decision to Q3.

I can push to get an engineering contact (Alex > alex.northfield@northfieldtrust.com) to share traffic traces.

From a sales perspective, we're willing to accept a 6-week MVP that covers one-time seeded KV snapshot + routed reserved pool if Product ships a clear activation plan and rollback. The commercial team is prepared to make the reserved capacity commitment contingent on a successful pilot.

Karthik
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodai.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T13:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Northfield Trust - ask for customer-specific KV seeding + 'lightning lane' prioritization

Quick ops notes:

- If we do seeded KV snapshots, we need to agree on retention and purge windows (they asked for 90-days retention for analytics; legal may push back on any PII in seeds). We'll require a spec for what prefixes are seeded and a scrubbed sample.
- For the reserved pool, we have capacity-management playbooks but adding a per-customer pinned mini-pool for month-end will need runbook updates and a small change to the autoscaler to respect manual pinning duration. Ops effort: ~2 engineer-weeks to add safe-guards to avoid noisy-neighbor leaks.
- Monitoring: we'll need per-tenant P95 and cold-start metrics surfaced to Console; adding this dashboard tile is another 1–2 engineer-weeks unless Product can accept a temporary log-export to their Datadog account.

Happy to join a quick sync with Northfield engineering to align on the purge/retention and monitoring preferences.

—Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodai.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodai.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>, Riley Park <riley.park@northfieldtrust.com>
Cc: Matthew Cho <mcho@northfieldtrust.com>, procurement@northfieldtrust.com
Date: 2027-04-09T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Northfield Trust - ask for customer-specific KV seeding + 'lightning lane' prioritization

Thanks all for the quick turn. To keep procurement moving, here are consolidated asks and proposed next steps we can put into the SOW:

1) MVP scope (6 weeks): one-time seeded per-tenant KV snapshot on onboarding; shared-cache with tenant keys acceptable for pilot.
2) Reserved "lightning lane": small pinned pool for month-end windows; affinity to full-fidelity model with documented fallback to a quantized variant if capacity exhausted. Ops to add autoscaler safe-guards (Monica noted ~2 wks).
3) Deliverables for SOW: implementation plan with milestones (feasibility signal by 4/12, dev schedule by 4/16), security scrub of seed payload, and monitoring plan (Console dashboard or log export).

Riley/Matthew — can you confirm RPS numbers above (1.6k sustained / bursts to 3.5k, 220rps peak)? Also confirm whether seeded payload may contain any customer PII (procurement mentioned redaction requirements). If you can confirm by EOD 4/11, we will include the commitments in the SOW and aim for procurement sign-off by 4/15.

If Product/Eng can give a feasibility + high-level scope note by 4/12, we will mark the milestone in HubSpot and push SOW delivery.

I'll schedule a 30-min cross-functional sync for Monday 4/12 10:30 PST — invite to follow.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwoodai.com
Attachments: northfield-map-reqs.pdf, SOW-draft-NF-47.docx
